annotations.title: Convert a baby's weight or length between units

description: Converts a weight (kg, g, lb, oz) or a length (cm, m, in, ft) to every common unit, so a measurement quoted in pounds and ounces or feet and inches can go into the growth tools, which take kg and cm. For '7 lb 4 oz' pass value 7, unit lb, extra 4; for '2 ft 3 in' pass value 2, unit ft, extra 3.

extra.description: Ounces to add when unit is lb, or inches to add when unit is ft.

locale.description: Language for the disclaimer and any clinician note. Pass the language you will answer the user in: these are clinical safety texts written by a paediatrician, and they should reach the reader as written rather than translated by the model.

unit.description: kg, g, lb, oz for weight; cm, m, in, ft for length.

value.description: The number in the given unit.

name: convert_measurement
title: Convert a baby's weight or length between units
